chapterInfo.content:
20
Paulo wɔ Makedonia ne Hela
1Na gyegyeegye no gyaeeɛ no, Paulo frɛɛ asuafoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtuu wɔn fo kraa wɔn firii hɔ sɛ, ɔrekɔ Makedonia. 2Na ɔtwaa mu hɔnom de nsɛm pii tuu wɔn fo, na ɔbaa Hela. 3Na ɔdii hɔ abosome mmiɛnsa; na ɔreyɛ atu akɔ Siria no, na Yudafoɔ retɛ no nti, ɔpatu sane bɛfaa Makedonia. 4#Aso 17.10; 19.29 Na Beroiani Sopater, Piro ba, ne Tesalonikafoɔ Aristarko ne Sekundo ne Derbeni Gaio ne Timoteo ne Asiafoɔ Tihiko ne Trofimo ka ne ho. 5#Aso 16.8 Yeinom dii kan kɔtwɛnee yɛn wɔ Troa. 6Na yɛn nso, Apiti nna twaa mu no, yɛfirii Filipi faa nsuo ani, na yɛde nnanum bɛduruu wɔn nkyɛn Troa; ɛhɔ na yɛdii nnanson.
Paulo ne Troas asɔremma di nkra
7 # 1 Ko 16.2; Aso 2.42; 2.46 Na nnawɔtwe mu da a ɛdi kan no a yɛhyiaa sɛ yɛrebubu paanoo no, Paulo kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ adeɛ kye a, ɔbɛkɔ, na ɔtoaa asɛm no so ara kɔsii ɔdasuo mu. 8Na nkanea bebree wɔ abansoro faako a yɛahyia mu hɔ. 9Na aberanteɛ bi a ne din de Eutiko te mpomma ano ada hatee, na ɛsiane sɛ Paulo kasa kyɛreeɛ nti, ɔtɔɔ nko firii aborɔsansa no so hwee ase, na wɔmaa no soɔ no, na wawu. 10#1 Ah 17.21 Na Paulo siane kɔbutuu ne so, na ɔyɛɛ no atuu kaa sɛ: Monnha mo ho, na nkwa da so ara wɔ ne mu. 11Na ɔforo bae, na ɔbubuu paanoo, na ɔdiiɛ no, ɔtoaa so kasae ara kɔsii adekyeeɛ, na ɔfirii hɔ kɔeɛ. 12Na wɔde abɔfra no baa wɔ anikan so, na ɛyɛɛ wɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ kɛseɛ.
Paulo firi Troas kɔ Mileto
13Na yɛdii kan kɔɔ suhyɛn mu faa nsuo ani kɔɔ Aso sɛ yɛrekɔfa Paulo wɔ hɔ; sɛdeɛ ɔhyehyɛeɛ ne no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa sɛ ɔbɛfa fam akɔ hɔ. 14Na ɔne yɛn hyiaa Aso no, yɛfaa no, na yɛbaa Mitilene. 15Na yɛtu firii hɔ, na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, yɛbɛduruu Kio ntentensoɔ; na adeɛ kyee bio no, yɛbɛduruu Samo; na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, yɛduruu Mileto. 16#Aso 18.21 Na Paulo aka sɛ ɔbɛsiane Efeso ho, na wankɔkyɛre Asia; ɛfiri sɛ na ɔrepɛ ntɛm, na sɛ ɔbɛtumi a, wakɔduru Yerusalem Pentekoste da.
Paulo ne Efeso mpanimfoɔ di nkra
17Na ɔfiri Mileto soma kɔɔ Efeso kɔhyiaa asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ. 18#Aso 18.19; 19.10 Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monim sɛdeɛ ɛfiri da a ɛdi kan a mebaa Asia no, me ne mo tenaa berɛ no nyinaa mu, 19na mede ahobrɛaseɛ adwene nyinaa ne nisuo pii, sɔhwɛ a ɛbaa me soɔ Yudafoɔ pɔ bɔne a wɔbɔɔ no me ho mu mesom Awurade. 20Na mansi deɛ ɛyɛ mfasoɔ mu biara so, sɛ ebia merenka menkyerɛ mo, na mekyerɛkyerɛɛ mo edwam ne afie mu, 21na medii Nyankopɔn fam adwensakyera ne Awurade Yesu Kristo mu gyidie ho adanseɛ mekyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ.
22 # Aso 19.21 Na afei, hwɛ, Honhom no hyɛ me nti, merekɔ Yerusalem, na mennim deɛ ɛbɛto me wɔ hɔ, 23#Aso 9.16; 21.4; 21.11 gye sɛ Honhom Kronkron di me adanseɛ nkuro nyinaa mu ka sɛ ɛkyerɛ ne amaneɛ retwɛn me. 24#Aso 21.13 Na memfa yei menyɛ biribi, nanso memmu me kra aboɔden memma me ho, na mede anigyeɛ mawie me nanteɛ ne ɔsom a menyaa no Awurade Yesu nkyɛn sɛ menni Nyankopɔn adom asɛmpa no ho adanseɛ.
25 # Aso 18.6 Na afei, hwɛ, menim sɛ mo a menam mo mu mekaa ahennie no ho asɛm no nyinaa renhunu m’anim bio. 26#Aso 18.6 Enti nnɛ medi mo adanseɛ sɛ, me ho afiri mo nyinaa mogya ho; 27ɛfiri sɛ mansi biribiara so, sɛ ebia merenka Nyankopɔn tiri mu agyina nyinaa menkyerɛ mo. 28#1 Ti 4.16; 1 Pe 5.2 Enti monhwɛ mo ho ne nnwankuo nyinaa a Honhom Kronkron de mo asisi wɔn so ahwɛfoɔ, sɛ mobɛyɛne Nyankopɔn asafo a ɔde ɔno ara mogya anya wɔn no yie. 29#Mat 7.15 Na menim sɛ, me korɔ akyiri no, mpataku bɔne bɛhyɛne mo mu a wɔrennyae nnwankuo no kwa. 30Nso mo ara mo mu nnipa bɛsɔre a wɔbɛka nkontomposɛm de atwe asuafoɔ no adi wɔn akyire. 31Enti monwɛn, monkae sɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ni, anadwo ne awia, mennyaee mo mu biara afotuo wɔ nisuo mu da.
32Na afei deɛ, mede mo hyɛ Onyankopɔn nsa ne n’adom asɛm mu; ɔno na ɔbɛtumi de mo asi hɔ, na wama mo agyapadeɛ wɔn a wɔate wɔn ho nyinaa mu. 33#Mat 10.8; 1 Ko 9.12; 1 Sa 12.3 M’ani ammere obiara dwetɛ anaa sika anaa atadeɛ. 34#Aso 18.3; 1 Ko 4.12; 1 Te 2.9 Mo ara monim sɛ, deɛ ɛhiaa me ne wɔn a wɔka me ho no, me nsa yi ano adwuma na mede menyaeɛ. 35Ne nyinaa mu, mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ adwuma saa de boa wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ, na mokae Awurade Yesu nsɛm a ɔkaa sɛ: Ɔma mu wɔ nhyira sene ɔgyeɛ. 36#Aso 21.5 Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔkotoo ne nankoroma anim ne wɔn nyinaa bɔɔ mpaeɛ. 37Na wɔn nyinaa suu pii, na wɔsosɔɔ Paulo kɔn fee n’ano. 38#Aso 20.25 Na deɛ ɛyɛɛ wɔn ya bebrebe ne asɛm a ɔkaa sɛ wɔrenhunu n’anim bio no. Na wɔkɔgyaa no kwan wɔ suhyɛn no mu.

Na gyegyeegye no gyaeeɛ no, Paulo frɛɛ asuafoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtuu wɔn fo kraa wɔn firii hɔ sɛ, ɔrekɔ Makedonia. Na ɔtwaa mu hɔnom de nsɛm pii tuu wɔn fo, na ɔbaa Hela. Na ɔdii hɔ abosome mmiɛnsa; na ɔreyɛ atu akɔ Siria no, na Yudafoɔ retɛ no nti, ɔpatu sane bɛfaa Makedonia. Na Beroiani Sopater, Piro ba, ne Tesalonikafoɔ Aristarko ne Sekundo ne Derbeni Gaio ne Timoteo ne Asiafoɔ Tihiko ne Trofimo ka ne ho. Yeinom dii kan kɔtwɛnee yɛn wɔ Troa. Na yɛn nso, Apiti nna twaa mu no, yɛfirii Filipi faa nsuo ani, na yɛde nnanum bɛduruu wɔn nkyɛn Troa; ɛhɔ na yɛdii nnanson.

Na nnawɔtwe mu da a ɛdi kan no a yɛhyiaa sɛ yɛrebubu paanoo no, Paulo kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ adeɛ kye a, ɔbɛkɔ, na ɔtoaa asɛm no so ara kɔsii ɔdasuo mu. Na nkanea bebree wɔ abansoro faako a yɛahyia mu hɔ. Na aberanteɛ bi a ne din de Eutiko te mpomma ano ada hatee, na ɛsiane sɛ Paulo kasa kyɛreeɛ nti, ɔtɔɔ nko firii aborɔsansa no so hwee ase, na wɔmaa no soɔ no, na wawu. Na Paulo siane kɔbutuu ne so, na ɔyɛɛ no atuu kaa sɛ: Monnha mo ho, na nkwa da so ara wɔ ne mu. Na ɔforo bae, na ɔbubuu paanoo, na ɔdiiɛ no, ɔtoaa so kasae ara kɔsii adekyeeɛ, na ɔfirii hɔ kɔeɛ. Na wɔde abɔfra no baa wɔ anikan so, na ɛyɛɛ wɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ kɛseɛ.

Na yɛdii kan kɔɔ suhyɛn mu faa nsuo ani kɔɔ Aso sɛ yɛrekɔfa Paulo wɔ hɔ; sɛdeɛ ɔhyehyɛeɛ ne no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa sɛ ɔbɛfa fam akɔ hɔ. Na ɔne yɛn hyiaa Aso no, yɛfaa no, na yɛbaa Mitilene. Na yɛtu firii hɔ, na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, yɛbɛduruu Kio ntentensoɔ; na adeɛ kyee bio no, yɛbɛduruu Samo; na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, yɛduruu Mileto. Na Paulo aka sɛ ɔbɛsiane Efeso ho, na wankɔkyɛre Asia; ɛfiri sɛ na ɔrepɛ ntɛm, na sɛ ɔbɛtumi a, wakɔduru Yerusalem Pentekoste da.

Na ɔfiri Mileto soma kɔɔ Efeso kɔhyiaa asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ. Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monim sɛdeɛ ɛfiri da a ɛdi kan a mebaa Asia no, me ne mo tenaa berɛ no nyinaa mu, na mede ahobrɛaseɛ adwene nyinaa ne nisuo pii, sɔhwɛ a ɛbaa me soɔ Yudafoɔ pɔ bɔne a wɔbɔɔ no me ho mu mesom Awurade. Na mansi deɛ ɛyɛ mfasoɔ mu biara so, sɛ ebia merenka menkyerɛ mo, na mekyerɛkyerɛɛ mo edwam ne afie mu, na medii Nyankopɔn fam adwensakyera ne Awurade Yesu Kristo mu gyidie ho adanseɛ mekyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ.
Na afei, hwɛ, Honhom no hyɛ me nti, merekɔ Yerusalem, na mennim deɛ ɛbɛto me wɔ hɔ, gye sɛ Honhom Kronkron di me adanseɛ nkuro nyinaa mu ka sɛ ɛkyerɛ ne amaneɛ retwɛn me. Na memfa yei menyɛ biribi, nanso memmu me kra aboɔden memma me ho, na mede anigyeɛ mawie me nanteɛ ne ɔsom a menyaa no Awurade Yesu nkyɛn sɛ menni Nyankopɔn adom asɛmpa no ho adanseɛ.
Na afei, hwɛ, menim sɛ mo a menam mo mu mekaa ahennie no ho asɛm no nyinaa renhunu m’anim bio. Enti nnɛ medi mo adanseɛ sɛ, me ho afiri mo nyinaa mogya ho; ɛfiri sɛ mansi biribiara so, sɛ ebia merenka Nyankopɔn tiri mu agyina nyinaa menkyerɛ mo. Enti monhwɛ mo ho ne nnwankuo nyinaa a Honhom Kronkron de mo asisi wɔn so ahwɛfoɔ, sɛ mobɛyɛne Nyankopɔn asafo a ɔde ɔno ara mogya anya wɔn no yie. Na menim sɛ, me korɔ akyiri no, mpataku bɔne bɛhyɛne mo mu a wɔrennyae nnwankuo no kwa. Nso mo ara mo mu nnipa bɛsɔre a wɔbɛka nkontomposɛm de atwe asuafoɔ no adi wɔn akyire. Enti monwɛn, monkae sɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ni, anadwo ne awia, mennyaee mo mu biara afotuo wɔ nisuo mu da.
Na afei deɛ, mede mo hyɛ Onyankopɔn nsa ne n’adom asɛm mu; ɔno na ɔbɛtumi de mo asi hɔ, na wama mo agyapadeɛ wɔn a wɔate wɔn ho nyinaa mu. M’ani ammere obiara dwetɛ anaa sika anaa atadeɛ. Mo ara monim sɛ, deɛ ɛhiaa me ne wɔn a wɔka me ho no, me nsa yi ano adwuma na mede menyaeɛ. Ne nyinaa mu, mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ adwuma saa de boa wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ, na mokae Awurade Yesu nsɛm a ɔkaa sɛ: Ɔma mu wɔ nhyira sene ɔgyeɛ. Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔkotoo ne nankoroma anim ne wɔn nyinaa bɔɔ mpaeɛ. Na wɔn nyinaa suu pii, na wɔsosɔɔ Paulo kɔn fee n’ano. Na deɛ ɛyɛɛ wɔn ya bebrebe ne asɛm a ɔkaa sɛ wɔrenhunu n’anim bio no. Na wɔkɔgyaa no kwan wɔ suhyɛn no mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
